links.note: Also is added in English.
Counted with renders being from the number of.
Jesus names the subject carried by the verb.
Jesus names the implicit subject of had told.
Longer adds a temporal qualification to the emphatic negative.
Again renders from now in the negative clause.
He took repeats the preceding action elliptically.
The copula is implicit.
The negative question has an implicit copula.
The compound pronoun also contains and.
Prayed renders the supplicatory verb; the dictionary has confused its lemma with bind.
The infinitive know is expanded into that you know.
Still is supplied in English.
Being fulfilled renders has an end.
As his custom was renders according to the custom.
Knelt down renders placing the knees.
Appeared renders the passive was seen.
His prayer renders the article with prayer.
A crowd appeared renders behold, a crowd.
What was about to happen renders the future participle what would be.
Greek says allow up to this; the English makes an understood action explicit.
Your hands renders the article with hands.
Jesus supplies the implicit object of denied.
One of them renders from among them.
After an hour passed renders an hour having separated.
The initial connective, quotation marker, and today are unexpressed.
Jesus names the referent of him.
The repeated object is implicit.
It supplies the object of say.
Own emphasizes the possessive.
